## Fiber T ypes

Muscle fibers are broadly categorized into two primary fiber types: Type I and Type II . Type I fibers, often referred to as slow-twitch fibers, are fatigue resistant and thus well suited for activities requiring local muscular endurance. However, peak tension takes time-approximately 110 ms-to achieve in these fibers, thereby limiting their ability to produce maximal force.
